# Now 2.13.72
- Click the album art in full screen to play or pause. The cover springs forward or settles back as it does, so the click confirms itself.

# Now 2.13.71
- Swipe up and down on the album art to change the volume, in both the desktop overlay and full screen. It moves in the same steps the volume keys use, and each step gives a small click, so you can feel how far you have moved without looking. As with changing track, it only works while the pointer is over the artwork. - A gesture now commits to one direction at the start, so a slightly diagonal swipe changes either the track or the volume, never a bit of both.

# Now 2.13.70
- Fixed the artwork flicker when changing track by swiping in full screen. The new cover arrived, briefly reverted to the previous one, then jumped to the new one again. The swipe was finishing on a fixed timer rather than waiting for the player, which takes up to a second to report a skip, so for a moment the view fell back to showing the cover it still had. It now holds the new cover until the player has genuinely caught up, and the handover is invisible. - Removed the tap when changing track by swiping. It was too faint to feel, so it was not earning its place.
